worked_solution:
The four fundamental subspaces of a matrix $A$ can be schematically visualized, as shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14093810/assets/889b83fadd26b377c4dd34143c9b16541630c04e90de3d9b005e7147ead75ad5.png)

In our case, we are given that $m=7,$ $n=9,$ and $n-r=3.$ 

Substituting $n=9$ into $n-r=3,$ we can find the rank of $A:$

$$
(9)-r=3\,⟹\,r=6
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{dim}(\text{Col}({A}^{T})) & =r=6.\end{aligned}
$$
